flagDescriptions.EMPTY: present but empty value (String absent vs empty, xs:list empty vs null, number/enum parse of "")
flagDescriptions.WHITESPACE_EDGE: leading or trailing whitespace (JAXB trims numbers/enums, keeps Strings)
flagDescriptions.MULTI_SPACE: consecutive spaces inside the value (xs:list collapse vs split(" "))
flagDescriptions.BOOL_NONCANONICAL: boolean literal in non-canonical case (True, FALSE, ...)
flagDescriptions.CONTROL_CHAR: tab, newline or other control character
flagDescriptions.MIXED_SHAPES: the same path has numeric and non-numeric literals
flagDescriptions.BOOL_MIXED_NUMERIC: the same path uses true/false and 0/1
flagDescriptions.ENUM_CASE_VARIANTS: the same path has literals differing only in case
flagDescriptions.MIXED_CONTENT: element has both child elements and non-whitespace text
